monday.focus_summary: Back width day: pull-ups into chest-supported and single-arm pulldown rows, face pulls for the rear delts, finished with a biceps curl and cable crunches.

Slight 0.5-1 second pause at the bottom, then lift your chest up and drive your elbows down as you lift yourself up. Don't be afraid to use assistance. Add weight if needed. Keep the form tight and controlled! After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set the chest pad up so you get a deep stretch on each rep. After 2 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Try to keep the cable and your wrist aligned in a straight line throughout the pull. Feel a nice, deep lat stretch at the top. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Pull the cable towards eye-level, with a slight pause at the bottom of each rep (when your arm is bent). After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Set up the cable at hand height and feel a deep stretch on each rep. Curl until the handle reaches the bench. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

No pausing between reps. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Once you are under the bar, set up your feet as you would a normal squat and then bring them forward ~3-6 inches. If your heels are raising at the bottom, you may need to bring your feet more forward. If your lower back is rounding at the bottom, try bringing your feet back a bit. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 6-8 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7 on your early sets and ~8 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Pick ONE exercise from your weak point's "Exercise #1" options and perform it for these sets and reps. The default here is the Shoulders weak point's first option, Meadows Incline DB Lateral Raise — swap it in-app for whichever weak point exercise you actually chose. After 1-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Only do this second weak point exercise if your weak point feels recovered (not sore or fatigued) from Exercise 1 - skip it if it's tired or sore. Pick ONE exercise from the same weak point's "Exercise #2" options. The default here is the Shoulders weak point's second option, Reverse Pec Deck - swap it in-app for whichever weak point exercise you actually chose. After 1-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Set up the cable at the lowest position. Maintain constant tension on the biceps. Slow, controlled reps! After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Feel a nasty stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative. Pause for 1 second in the stretch part of each rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Keep your upper back planted against the bench. Go light on these and focus on feeling your biceps pull and squeeze. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your triceps to move the weight. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Allow your lower back to round as you curl your legs up. 10-20 reps is a broad range on purpose: just go until you hit RPE 9-10 (0-1 reps shy of failure) with controlled form. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-20 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

monday.focus_summary: Back thickness day: deficit rows, neutral-grip pulldowns and cable rows build the lats and mid-back, with preacher curls, a stretch-focused rear delt flye, and shrugs to close it out.

exercises.exercise_description: Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep! Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps in the bottom half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 3-4 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Do these pulldowns with the handle more out in front of you, more like a cross between a pullover and a pulldown. Focus on feeling your lats working more than the weight you're using. On all sets, alternate full-ROM reps and half-ROM reps until you've reached the target reps (partial reps count towards the rep count). After 2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Try to keep your forearm in line with the cable throughout the pull. Smooth, controlled reps. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Keep your triceps firmly pinned against the pad as you curl. No pausing at the top or bottom: constant tension on the biceps! After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Face side on to the machine and pull your arm across your body to pre-stretch your rear delt. Do reverse flyes 1 arm at a time. Start with your weaker arm. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Use controlled momentum and leg drive to shrug the weight up and then CONTROL the negative. Each negative should last 1-2 seconds. Shrug explosively! After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

exercises.exercise_description: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Set the bench at a ~15° incline. 1 second pause on the chest on each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Keep tension on the shoulders at the bottom. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Flare your elbows out at about 45° and keep your elbows locked in place as you complete the extensions. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Do one set with low cable position, one set with medium-height cable position, and one set with a high cable position. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

exercises.exercise_description: The RPE is intentionally low here because these will cause a lot of muscle damage. Don't be tempted to go too heavy. To keep tension on the hamstrings, stop about 75% of the way to full lockout on each rep (i.e. stay in the bottom 3/4 of the range of motion). After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~6 on your early sets and ~6-7 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding. Control the negative and do a slight pause at the bottom of each rep. After 2-4 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-10 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~8-9 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Minimize contribution from the back leg. Mind-muscle connection with your glutes here! After the final set for each leg, perform a quad static stretch for that leg for 30 seconds. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps per leg. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets per leg

Squeeze your glutes hard at the top of each rep. Slow controlled reps on the way down, followed by an explosive positive. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs. These are great for adding thigh mass from the front! Push them hard! After 1-2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

No pausing between reps. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~7-8 on your early sets and ~9 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

The default here is the Shoulders weak point's first option, Meadows Incline DB Lateral Raise — swap it in-app for whichever weak point exercise you actually chose. After 1-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Only do this second weak point exercise if your weak point feels recovered (not sore or fatigued) from Exercise 1 - skip it if it's tired or sore. Pick ONE exercise from the same weak point's "Exercise #2" options. The default here is the Shoulders weak point's second option, Reverse Pec Deck - swap it in-app for whichever weak point exercise you actually chose. After 1-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 8-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-3 min between sets. 3 total work sets

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Smooth, controlled reps. Mind-muscle connection with the biceps. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

exercises.exercise_name: Triceps Diverging Pressdown (Long Rope or 2 Ropes)
exercises.exercise_description: Use two long ropes or one long rope. Lean slightly forward, flare your elbows slightly out and keep your arms back in line with your torso. Then do triceps pressdowns, getting a full, big squeeze at the bottom. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Do a hammer curl on the positive, then turn your palms facing up at the top and use a palms-up grip on the negative. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

As many reps as possible. Keep them controlled! Roughly shoulder-width hand placement. Keep elbows tucked close to your sides. Smooth, controlled reps. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 AMRAP sets to the target RPE. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Don't just bend at your hips, use your abs to lower yourself down under control and pull yourself back up. If you don't have the core strength to get all the way extended at the bottom, try to progressively increase the ROM week to week. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

monday.focus_summary: Back thickness day: Pendlay deficit rows, single-arm pulldowns and seated cable rows for the mid-back, hammer curls, a stretch-focused rear delt flye, and shrugs.

exercises.exercise_description: Stand on a bumper plate. Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep! Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps. These should be the bottom half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank. After 2-3 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 3-4 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Keep elbow tucked in close to your torso. Focus on squeezing your lat to move the weight. On all sets, alternate full-ROM reps and half-ROM reps until you've reached the target reps (partial reps count towards the rep count). After 2 warm-up sets, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together, drive your elbows down and back. After 1 warm-up set, do 2 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets

Squeeze the rope hard as you curl the weight up. Smooth, controlled reps. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 10-12 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Face side on to the machine and pull your arm across your body to pre-stretch your rear delt. Do reverse flyes 1 arm at a time. Start with your weaker arm. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Use controlled momentum and leg drive to shrug the weight up and then CONTROL the negative. Each negative should last 1-2 seconds. Shrug explosively! After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

tuesday.focus_summary: Push day: cuffed lateral raises and seated DB shoulder press for the delts, low-incline DB pressing and a cable crossover ladder for the chest, finished with skull crushers for triceps.

exercises.exercise_description: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep. After 1 warm-up set, do 3 sets of 12-15 reps. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~6 on your early sets and ~6-7 on your last set resting 3-5 min between sets. 3 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~8-9 on your early sets and ~9-10 on your last set resting 2-3 min between sets. 2 total work sets per leg

All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 4 total work sets

Aim for an RPE of ~9 on your early sets and ~10 on your last set resting 1-2 min between sets. 2 total work sets
